classification.source_level_rationale: created in the course of the activity it documents: This is a contemporary administrative file documenting a specific parliamentary motion and its discussion during the Wintersession 2001.
classification.resume: This is an audio recording of a debate in the Swiss National Council during the Wintersession 2001 concerning a postulate by Alex Heim on transparency regarding the rail freight transport concept. The debate includes discussion of possible scenarios for shifting goods transport to rail. The record captures parliamentary proceedings rather than a legislative text or external report.
